layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Asymmetric, editorial, generous negative space, left-aligned focus
layout_and_spacing.grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with asymmetric spanning (e.g. col-span-5 vs col-span-7) to avoid boxy symmetry.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Framer motion fade-up and blur-in on scroll triggers. Staggered reveals for lists.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Subtle -translate-y-1, image zoom inside container (scale-105) for collage, text opacity shifts for links.
motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis for premium momentum scrolling feeling.

components.navigation: Sticky top navigation, backdrop-blur-xl (crystal glass), z-50. Include logo/name, links: Intro, Work, Values, Background, References, Contact. Add theme toggle (sun/moon) and 'Download Resume' button.
components.hero: Editorial split layout. Left: Massive typographic statement, left-aligned. Right: Image collage of past work (overlapping absolute positioned images with subtle shadows).
components.values: Large statement display. Text heavily contrasting background. E.g., 'Useful, Considered, Beautiful, Well-made.'
components.work_history: Detailed timeline list. Left column (md:col-span-3) for dates, Right column (md:col-span-9) for Company, Role, Location, and Description. Generous spacing between items.
components.testimonials: Asymmetric grid layout, large quotation marks, serif font for the quote itself to add contrast (optional), attribution below.
components.accolades: Minimalist list/table, border-b on items, hover state adds subtle background tint.
components.contact: Massive typography for email CTA (e.g., text-5xl+), LinkedIn link, accompanied by the professional headshot image.

image_urls.description: Main dark dashboard UI design mockup

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup Lucide React or Phosphor Icons for iconography.
Install framer-motion for page transitions and scroll reveals.
Install next-themes (or equivalent) for robust light/dark mode toggling.
Import Outfit font via Google Fonts (or similar) for all headings, keep Inter for body.
Do NOT use space grotesk for fonts.
Do NOT use teal or purple gradients.
Build Shadcn components (Button, Sheet, etc.) avoiding the generic default look. Ensure 'Download Resume' CTA is prominent.
Ensure the hero section mimics an editorial layout: giant typography on one side, stacked overlapping images on the other.
Ensure high contrast ratios (text over background) in both themes.
